displacement_simulations.impact_summary: A 50% enforcement surge at Walayar Checkpost (NH 544) suppresses direct highway transit into Palakkad/Ernakulam. Smuggling networks exhibit route displacement into the northern Wayanad corridor (36%) and modal substitution into railway parcel logistics (22%).
A 50% enforcement surge at Muthanga Checkpost (NH 766) diverts Bengaluru synthetic flow southward into Walayar trunk and northward into Kasaragod coastal highways.
A 50% enforcement surge at Thalappady Border (NH 66) diverts Goa/Mangalore synthetic consignments inland toward Wayanad Ghat passes and Konkan express railway parcel networks.
A 50% enforcement surge at Kumily Checkpost (NH 183) redirects High Range mountain traffic northward to Bodimettu pass and southward to Aryankavu ghats.
A 50% enforcement surge at Aryankavu Checkpost (NH 744) forces southern interstate flow into Amaravila coastal passes and Kumily mountain feeder routes.
